title: Package Download and Filesystem Operations

use_cases.name: Download Package
use_cases.description: DownloadManager.download(package, targetDir) selects source (dist/source), delegates to correct DownloaderInterface impl

use_cases.name: Install Package
use_cases.description: DownloadManager.install(package, targetDir) delegates to FileDownloader or VcsDownloader install()

use_cases.name: Update Package
use_cases.description: DownloadManager.update(initial, target, targetDir) re-downloads and re-installs updated package

use_cases.name: Remove Package
use_cases.description: DownloadManager.remove(package, targetDir) delegates to downloader.remove(), then Filesystem.removeDirectory()

use_cases.name: Prepare Download
use_cases.description: DownloadManager.prepare(type, package, targetDir) sets up pre-download state

use_cases.name: Cleanup After Download
use_cases.description: DownloadManager.cleanup(type, package, targetDir) removes temp files after install/update/remove

use_cases.name: Download File via HTTP
use_cases.description: FileDownloader.download() uses HttpDownloader.addCopy(url, fileName) to fetch dist archive; dispatches PreFileDownloadEvent and PostFileDownloadEvent

use_cases.name: Load Package from Cache
use_cases.description: FileDownloader checks Cache.sha1(cacheKey); if hit calls cache.copyTo(cacheKey, fileName); on download success calls cache.copyFrom(cacheKey, fileName)

use_cases.name: Verify File Checksum
use_cases.description: FileDownloader computes hash_file('sha1', fileName) and compares with package.getDistSha1Checksum(); throws on mismatch

use_cases.name: Remove Directory
use_cases.description: Filesystem.removeDirectory(directory) recursively removes a directory; async variant removeDirectoryAsync() also available

use_cases.name: Ensure Directory Exists
use_cases.description: Filesystem.ensureDirectoryExists(directory) creates directory if missing; called by FileDownloader and DownloadManager before writing

use_cases.name: Copy and Move Files
use_cases.description: Filesystem.copy(source, target), rename(source, target), copyThenRemove(source, target) for archive extraction output

use_cases.name: Compare Package Changes
use_cases.description: FileDownloader.getLocalChanges(): downloads package to temp _compare dir, uses Comparer to diff against installed version, then removeDirectory(_compare)

use_cases.name: Fall Back to Alternative Source
use_cases.description: On RuntimeException (non-IrrecoverableDownloadException) DownloadManager retries download with next source (dist→source or vice versa) if sourceFallback enabled

use_cases.name: Select Download Source (dist vs source)
use_cases.description: DownloadManager.getAvailableSources() returns ordered list based on preferDist/preferSource flags and per-package preferences

key_relationships: Developer initiates UC1, UC2, UC3, UC4 via DownloadManager API
DownloadManager delegates download/install/update/remove to DownloaderInterface (FileDownloader or VcsDownloader)
DownloadManager uses Filesystem for ensureDirectoryExists and normalizeTargetDir
FileDownloader uses HttpDownloader for HTTP file transfer
FileDownloader uses Cache to avoid redundant downloads
FileDownloader uses EventDispatcher to emit PreFileDownloadEvent and PostFileDownloadEvent
FileDownloader uses Filesystem for ensureDirectoryExists and remove operations
VcsDownloader uses Filesystem for directory cleanup
important_notes: FileDownloader is the base for all dist (archive) downloaders (zip, tar, etc.). VcsDownloader is the base for source downloaders (git, svn, hg). DownloadManager dispatches based on installationSource (dist vs source). Fallback logic retries with alternative source on recoverable RuntimeException. Cache uses SHA1 checksums for validation. All download/install/update/remove methods return React\Promise\PromiseInterface for async execution.
